_comment: Businesses that have opted out of Chaffee Provides. Nothing listed here may appear anywhere the site publishes: sync_data.py removes them, and scripts/opt_outs.py (run by sync_data.py, build_export.py and CI) fails if a name, alias, id, slug, address or web address from an entry is found in the data, the descriptions, the photos, the Guidestone export or the pages. This is a permanent block, not a seasonal hide: use scope.json exclude_slugs for a business that is only closed or not wanted. Never delete an entry; if a business later opts back in, set reinstated_on and reinstated_note, keep the entry, and get Guidestone's written okay first. name: the business as it is listed. aliases: other names, including the names of its shops, stands and markets. ids / slugs: Food Web ids and slugs (a slug ending -outlet also matches without it). urls: web and social addresses, written without https:// or www. emails: addresses. recorded_by: who relayed the opt-out. note: the evidence in plain words.

opted_out.name: The Triangle Oasis
opted_out.note: The Triangle Oasis has opted out of participating in Chaffee Provides. Remove the farm, its Market on Main St. shop and any mention of them; do not show them in any future product built from this data.
